He noted that whereas Cold War-era survivalists were often focused on nuclear conflict, modern preppers worry about terrorism, climate disasters, geopolitical threats and emerging technologies. Supermarkets across Europe have been hit by a suspected cyber-attack affecting their fridges and freezers, and raising concern about the vulnerabilities of internet-connected hardware from industrial machinery to humble domestic appliances. Smart devices which are connected to the internet can include fridges, central heating, and even washing machines. And while that makes them easier to control remotely, in theory, any device which goes online can potentially be exploited by malicious actors.

He made his big league debut in 1967, but joined the Mets full time in 1968, going 19-12 with a 2.08 ERA and 178 strikeouts in 263.2 innings. stories.title: Barcelona send scouts to watch 18-year-old Portuguese defender – report
stories.summary: Barcelona are keeping tabs on Portuguese defensive prospect Jordan Arnolin after sending a scout to watch the 18-year-old during Estoril Praia’s 0-4 defeat against FC Porto, according to a report fr... The outlet mentions that a representative of the Catalan club was present at the Estadio do Dragao to assess the young defender, who was making his first start for Estoril Praia. Although his side suffered a heavy defeat, Arnolin attracted attention with his versatility and ability to operate in several positions. Arnolin is naturally a centre-back but can also operate as a full-back or defensive midfielder, a profile similar to their youth team gem Xavi Espart.

stories.title: NBA Power Rankings: Thunder stun over bad injury luck; Sixers, Grizzlies top surprises
stories.summary: NBA Power Rankings: Oklahoma City Thunder stun over bad injury luck; Philadelphia 76ers, Memphis Grizzlies top surprises. Of course, the Oklahoma City Thunder are the unfortunate poster child for bad injury luck. They're completely decimated with injuries. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander is all alone as their next three best players will be out for two-plus months. On the bright side, the Philadelphia 76ers and Memphis Grizzlies have been the biggest surprise stories. For completely different reasons, too. The Sixers' star-studded cast has needed zero time to gel. And the Grizzlies' youthful roster is playing ahead of schedule.
